query:
SELECT 'directory'::TEXT AS kind, dir_id AS id
FROM sync_directory_state
WHERE library_id = $1 AND dir_id = ANY($2::TEXT[])
  AND component = 'lifecycle' AND value = 'present'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'book'::TEXT, book_id
FROM sync_book_lifecycle_state
WHERE library_id = $1 AND book_id = ANY($3::TEXT[])
UNION ALL
SELECT 'book'::TEXT, book_id
FROM sync_book_placement_state
WHERE library_id = $1 AND book_id = ANY($3::TEXT[]);
